inherits.rule: V4.2 hardens remaining Phase357 false negatives and calibrates the simulated target reader without rewriting historical verdicts.

V4.2-G0P.name: TARGET_READER_PROFILE_CALIBRATION
V4.2-G0P.pass_condition: The evaluator knows the declared reader-experience contract but not known failure locations or answer keys.

V4.2-G1M.name: REENTRY_DECISION_DELTA_WITH_TEXTUAL_EVIDENCE
V4.2-G1M.pass_condition: Every material post-withdrawal reversal has a located post-choice delta textually available to the returning character before re-entry.

V4.2-G5D.name: MANUSCRIPT_LEVEL_DRAMATIZATION_SURFACE_DENSITY_V1_1
V4.2-G5D.pass_condition: After functional masking, separated high-stakes scenes do not repeatedly collapse into the same thin event-transmission machine; unique props/history must actively alter scene behavior or felt transition.

V4.2-G5Q.name: SUSPENSE_CURIOSITY_CHARGE_V1_1
V4.2-G5Q.pass_condition: Material mysteries create answer-specific desire, not merely danger interest or a coherent theory; answer-value ablation and model-delta/desire-delta checks pass.

V4.2-G6N.name: NATURAL_SPEECH_UNDER_PRESSURE_V1_2
V4.2-G6N.pass_condition: Live high-information speech passes earliest-sufficient-warning, information-role-stack, listener-turn counterfactual, shared-context subtraction and visible-evidence carrier tests.

V4.2-G9H.name: LOCATED_HUMAN_TARGET_READER_AUTHORITY
V4.2-G9H.pass_condition: No unresolved located human target-reader failure remains on the candidate SHA.
